text.headline: Nighttime glucose and heart rate were high with fewer evening doses and very short sleep

sentences.text: Glucose was clearly above her usual at night and heart rate was far above her usual at night.
Missed doses on the same day or the day before were present and clearly fewer doses were taken than usual in the evening.
Short sleep the night before was present and was among the very lowest she has had, and this has come up before.
Low activity the day before has tended to move together with higher glucose between meals, and this has come up before.
The day's mood record, last night's sleep, and where she was that day are not known yet.
